# ColorPicker

**Class:** `UltraCanvasColorPicker` · **Group:** [Pickers, dialogs and feedback](../Groups/Pickers-dialogs-and-feedback.md) · **Header:** [`UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasColorPicker.h`](../../../UltraCanvas/include/UltraCanvasColorPicker.h) · `#include "UltraCanvasColorPicker.h"`

**Inherits:** [`UltraCanvasContainer`](UltraCanvasContainer.md) → [`UltraCanvasUIElement`](UltraCanvasUIElement.md) → `Element`

## What it is for

Colour (wheel, SV area, hue × lightness field or colour + intensity sliders; optional design selector)

## Overview

A container, not a bare element: the value being typed is edited in a real UltraCanvasTextInput child that moves to whichever field is in edit mode, rather than a private buffer painted by hand.

## Creating it

Factory functions (the usual way - every element is held in a `std::shared_ptr`):

```cpp
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasColorPicker> CreateColorPicker( const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
std::shared_ptr<UltraCanvasColorPicker> CreateColorPicker( const std::string& identifier, const Color& initial, float x = -1, float y = -1, float w = 290, float h = 470);
```

Constructors:

```cpp
UltraCanvasColorPicker(const std::string& identifier, float x, float y, float w, float h);
UltraCanvasColorPicker(const std::string& identifier, float w, float h);
explicit UltraCanvasColorPicker(const std::string& identifier);
```

The first string argument is always the element's **identifier**, never its text (see [Core concepts](../Core-Concepts.md#identifiers)).

### enum `ColorPickerModel`

|---|---|
| `HSV` |  |

### enum `ColorPickerModeSelector`

The HSV/HSL/RGB model can be switched either with a clickable tab bar or with a dropdown button; the two presentations are mutually exclusive.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `TabBar` | row of HSV \| HSL \| RGB tabs (default) |
| `Dropdown` | compact dropdown button |

### enum `ColorPickerSliderStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Thin` | thin track with the handle overhanging it (default) |
| `Thick` | thick bar that fully encloses the control point |

### enum `ColorPickerWheelStyle`

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Ring` | circular hue ring with the SV square inscribed (default) |
| `Bar` | maximised SV rectangle with a hue bar underneath |
| `HueLightnessField` | Hue x lightness field at full saturation: hue runs top (red) to bottom through the spectrum, lightness left (black) through the pure colour to right (white). One click picks colour and intensity. |
| `HueLightnessSliders` | Two sliders: a hue ("colour") bar, and an intensity bar running from white through the pure colour to black. Full saturation, as above. |

### enum `ColorPickerSVAreaShape`

The Ring style's SV area is always the square inscribed in the ring; the Bar style's area can stretch over all the space above the controls or keep 1:1.

| Value | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `Fill` | stretch to all the space above the controls (default) |
| `Square` | 1:1, as large as fits |
| `PixelExact` | 1:1 at 256 x 256 pixels - one pixel per 8-bit step of saturation and of value, so every pixel is a different colour and none is skipped. Smaller only when the widget has no room for it. |
